name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Split.preimage_congr
title: Gaussian preimages depend only on the cosets: equal coset families give equal preimage laws
statement: For matrices B (n x m) and B' (n' x m) over Z_q and targets P (n x k), P' (n' x k): if for every column j and every integer vector x, B x = P_j (mod q) iff B' x = P'_j (mod q), then Trapdoor.preimage B P tau = Trapdoor.preimage B' P' tau (the column-wise coset Gaussian preimage laws are equal).
